title: Bifurcation structure and mesa pattern formation in a one-component nonlocal adhesion model with population pressure and degenerate mobility
summary: We analyze pattern formation from a homogeneous steady state in a one-component nonlocal adhesion model with population pressure and degenerate mobility. First, using linear stability analysis, we derive the instability threshold and a selection rule for the fastest-growing mode, and elucidate the mechanism by which the selected wavenumber shifts toward lower wavenumbers as the mean density increases.
